case.physical_model: Single-phase inviscid reactive Euler, LiDryer, transverse uniform periodic strip; no droplets, diffusion or transverse perturbation.
case.initialization: Near-CJ finite-rate ZND at 1.00001 D_CJ; no forcing or imposed wave speed after initialization.

comparison_method: Shock-aligned cell-center samples; errors normalized by fixed reference jumps, same physical window at every resolution.
